sub_parameters.name: desc
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to sort in descending order. Valid values:

- true (default): yes
- false: no

sub_parameters.name: sortField
sub_parameters.description:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:

- event_time: event creation time
- event_execute_start_time: event execution time
- event_execute_finish_time: event completion time

parameters.name: eventCreateEndTime
parameters.description: The end time for querying by event creation time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventCreateStartTime
parameters.description: The start time for querying by event creation time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventCycleStatus
parameters.description: The lifecycle status object of the event.

parameters.name: eventExecuteEndTime
parameters.description: The end time for querying by event execution time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventExecuteStartTime
parameters.description: The start time for querying by event execution time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventFinashEndTime
parameters.description: The end time for querying by event completion time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventFinashStartTime
parameters.description: The start time for querying by event completion time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: nodeIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the node that triggered the event.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The starting document offset. The value must be a non-negative number. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of events to return. The value must be a non-negative number. Default value: 10.
